purpose: Exercise early warning, late warning, and false-alarm handling for a small manufacturer's supplier delay. These fixtures are not live inventory data.

proposed_human_actions: Ask supplier for a confirmed dispatch time and shipment evidence
Check alternative supplier or nearby-site stock
Assess partial fulfilment and prepare a customer update if unresolved by Tuesday afternoon
approval_constraints: Human approval required before switching suppliers
Human approval required before sending a customer commitment
AI must not autonomously place purchase orders or promise delivery

scenarios.title: Early supplier-delay warning

evidence.claim: Estimated delivery revised from Wednesday to Friday afternoon
40 units on hand; stated usage is 10 units/day

scenarios.risk_hypothesis: Available stock may be insufficient to protect the Friday morning customer order if the revised supplier estimate is accurate.
counter_evidence_to_check: Another site may have transferable stock
Supplier may ship earlier or partially fulfil
scenarios.reason: The source records are synthetic and not independently verified; recommend investigation, not autonomous action.

scenarios.title: Late supplier-delay warning

evidence.claim: Shipment is now expected Friday afternoon

scenarios.risk_hypothesis: The warning may arrive too late to secure enough stock before the customer deadline.
counter_evidence_to_check: Confirm whether the customer deadline has flexibility
scenarios.reason: The data is unverified and the intervention window may already be inadequate; escalate to a human immediately.

scenarios.title: Supplier-delay false alarm

evidence.claim: Delivery still scheduled for Wednesday; Friday estimate was a mistaken draft
40 units on hand; stated usage is 10 units/day

scenarios.risk_hypothesis: The initial alert may be a false alarm if the original Wednesday delivery is confirmed.
counter_evidence_to_check: Obtain supplier confirmation from an authenticated channel
Verify current stock and actual consumption
scenarios.reason: Conflicting supplier claims must be reconciled before the alert is cleared or action is authorized.
